channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran to hold talks with Qatar on MoU deal with US, frozen assets
item.description: Iran says it will hold indirect talks with mediator Qatar, to discuss implementing its MoU deal with the US.

item.title: US envoys in Doha for indirect talks with Iranian technical delegation
item.description: Iran says it has sent an expert delegation to Doha to follow up on the release of frozen Iranian funds.

item.title: Are US and Iranian negotiators meeting in Doha? What we know about talks
item.description: Trump says Iran wants to meet in Qatar after attacks, but Tehran says it is sending a delegation only over frozen funds.

item.title: Man in Gaza survives double tap Israeli strike on vehicle
item.description: Man in Gaza survives double tap Israeli strike on vehicle

item.title: Video: At least two killed and hundreds displaced in Israeli attack on Gaza
item.description: An Israeli attack on the al-Mawasi camp in Khan Younis has killed several people, including a mother and her child.

item.title: US envoys in Doha to meet mediators but not Iranians, Qatar says
item.description: Qatar's foreign ministry spokesman says no high-level meetings or direct talks between the US and Iran are scheduled.

item.title: Europe's heatwave linked to 1,300 deaths, WHO says, as Germany hits record 41.7C
item.description: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that Europe is not prepared for high temperatures.

item.title: Rescuers keep up search for survivors at collapsed La Guaira building
item.description: At least 1,700 people are known to have been killed in the disaster but hope remains that others can continue to be found alive.

item.title: What do we know about the shooting in Stade, Germany?
item.description: The BBC's Jessica Parker reports from the scene of the shooting that killed six people in northern Germany.
